title: ClearHash: code, sample, ledgers and analysis for "Verifying Attested Packages with Network-Isolated Builds"
description:
Code, study plan, sampling frame, per-release ledgers and analysis behind the paper "Verifying Attested Packages with Network-Isolated Builds: A Paired Rebuild Study of npm and PyPI". It contains the ClearHash verifier and the study driver, the BigQuery query and the 600 npm and 600 PyPI releases that were drawn, the 3,600 rebuild records and three rerun ledgers, and the analysis code and its output.

The tool versions used are the commits tagged hv-freeze (c3c9082) and hv-freeze-2 (77424cf). This archive is a later commit, 08ec3a3, which also holds the plan, the analysis and the paper source. The ledgers have build-host paths replaced with placeholders. The plan is docs/specs/hermetic-verifiability.md, and study/analysis reproduces every number in the paper from the ledgers with python hv_analysis.py.

The deps.dev BigQuery snapshot of 9 November 2026 is not included; study/frame/candidates.sql and the seed in the plan redraw the same sample.

Use of AI tools: I used Claude (Anthropic) to assist with writing the code, the analysis and the manuscript. I reviewed all code, text and results and take full responsibility for the content.
